lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County Planning Commission's all-day meeting on October 8, which opens with a joint BOCC work session on an Affordable Housing Code Update — about as close to the root of this valley's housing crisis as any single agenda gets. SMART's board also meets virtually that same day to vote on amending the Gondola Project Development IGA for FY27 and to kick off budget talks over how to allocate $5.2 million a year in tax revenue. Elsewhere, a public hearing on special event liquor permits for the Telluride Horror Show lands October 14, and the Ballot Measure 5A Information Meeting on Monday is worth your time if you haven't sorted out where you stand on that one yet.
